title: Google Ads Domain Checker input
description: Check a list of domains against the Google Ads Transparency Center. Every field has a working default; the prefilled domains run in under a minute.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains to check, one per line. Full URLs are accepted: the scheme, the www. prefix, the path and the query are stripped, the host is lower-cased and duplicates are removed. Soft cap 10,000 per run.

advertiserIds.title: Advertiser IDs (experimental)
advertiserIds.description: Optional Google advertiser IDs (AR followed by digits), one per line, checked in addition to the domains. Each ID is its own target: its rows carry the ID in the domain field and the advertiser id and name from Google. Verified working anonymously on 2026-10-28, but flagged experimental because one vendor reported HTTP 400 on this filter.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: check = one summary row per domain (event domain-check). ads = one row per creative (event ad-row). both = both row types in the same dataset; the row_type field tells them apart.

region.title: Region
region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (for example US, GB, DE, HU) to restrict results to ads shown in that country, or anywhere for no restriction. Ad counts and samples differ by region.

sampleSize.title: Sample size (check mode)
sampleSize.description: Number of most-recent creatives read per domain in check mode to derive last_seen, formats, the longest-running ad and change detection. 100 creatives = 1 request. Google returns creatives ordered by last-shown date descending, so last_seen is exact even for small samples.

maxAdsPerDomain.title: Max ads per domain (ads mode)
maxAdsPerDomain.description: Pagination cap per domain in ads and both modes, 100 creatives per request. Some vendors report Google stopping around 1,000 creatives per query; split by region if you hit it.

activeWindowDays.title: Active window (days)
activeWindowDays.description: A creative or advertiser counts as active now when its last-shown date is within this many days of the run.

trackChanges.title: Track changes between runs
trackChanges.description: Remember the creatives seen per domain in a named key-value store and report new and ended creatives on the next run. Free. Combine with a Schedule for monitoring.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Name of the key-value store that holds the per-domain creative snapshot used by change tracking (3-63 letters, digits or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen). Use a different name per monitoring list; snapshots are kept per region automatically.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Google rate-limits datacenter IPs quickly (HTTP 429, then a reCAPTCHA redirect), so Apify RESIDENTIAL proxies are the default. Switch to datacenter at your own risk: blocked domains are reported with status error and are never charged.

requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests per session (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Minimum pause between two requests on the same proxy session. 1,000 ms (one request per second per IP) is the known-safe rate.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel sessions
maxConcurrency.description: How many targets are fetched at the same time, each on its own proxy session. 4 is the known-safe default; higher values risk a pool-wide block.
